narrative.overview: The join screen centers a bracketed wordmark and two fields against a charcoal backdrop. In the room, the same wordmark moves into the sidebar and the conversation gets the available space. Red connects the room code, the sender’s own messages, and the action that sends the next one.
keyCharacteristics: A white CHAT and red CODE sit between muted brackets.
Square message bubbles distinguish authors by both position and fill.
Compact uppercase labels sit beside mixed-case conversation text.
dos: Pair outgoing red with right alignment and incoming charcoal with left alignment.
Keep author names and timestamps outside the message bubble.
Use the sidebar for room membership and keep message entry in the bottom bar.
donts: Avoid pill-shaped message bubbles and primary buttons.
Avoid decorative shadows on panels or messages.
